key_format: [t, value, ease]; ease = Godot Tween TRANS_x/EASE_y name (lin, quad_in, quad_out, quad_inout, back_out, sine_inout) applied from this key to the next
anchors_note: relative to Pip centre (x lane, y 1574); follow Pip every frame. C = paws/nose catch point, B = back pocket

fly.arc_note: perpendicular bulge = arc · d, away from lane centre

flight.path: quadratic: from C, ctrl = (C.x + 0.25·(chip.x − C.x), C.y − 260), to chip

hud.toast: unchanged: "+1 Name" under SeedChip, 1.4 s, max 2 (run_pickup_feed.gd)

streak.note: coin contacts ≤ 0.6 s apart raise n (1..5); same rule as the rising coin tone

rules: collect(): collision off, signal collected as today; node stays and plays event (no queue_free until event end)
z < 2 drawn under Pip, z >= 2 over Pip
own: true = the pickup node itself continues (no new sprite)
Pip anim (event.pip) starts at event t = 0 via _pip_play; a higher-priority overlay is not interrupted by a lower one
